findings.body: The new field `pub reasoning_effort: String,` is added to the `Models` struct with no `#[serde(default)]` attribute visible in the diff. If the struct does not have a container-level `#[serde(default)]`, any existing config file (custom configs, preset overrides, or any `[models]` table shipped elsewhere) that does not specify `reasoning_effort` will fail to deserialize — a hard error on the first review, rather than falling back to the old behaviour of disabling reasoning. The defaults.toml itself is fine because it sets the field, but the field is now required for every config that deserializes into `Models`.
findings.rule: New required serde field breaks existing configs that omit it
findings.title: Add #[serde(default)] to reasoning_effort so existing configs still parse

value.summary: The change is mostly sound: `reasoning_options` correctly maps `"off"`/`""` to disabled reasoning and passes other efforts through, the wire from config to gateway is tested, and the pricing tests cover the new models and argument-order hazards. One concern: the new `reasoning_effort` field on `Models` has no visible `#[serde(default)]`, so config files that omit it may fail to deserialize — but this depends on whether the struct has a container-level default that I cannot see from the diff.
